title: Audit Q8 dirty spectator restoration boundary
body:
## Summary

Adds an independent exact audit of the dirty-state boundary in the mixed-negative Q8 attainment proposal from PR #3697, pinned at `b5fa8645bff6db3ff219815e6fc820a4f08b0572`.

- The coordinate projector `N = e_a e_a^T` makes each three-call witness a full diagonal operator over `F2[Q8]`. Every non-target register remains exactly `[1]` for any role count.
- Adds a three-call legal rank-one negative control. Its diagonal is `([zi],[1])`, but its lower-left entry is `[1]+[zi]`. It passes a diagonal-only check and fails full-matrix equality; each of the eight dirty Q8 basis values changes when the target input is `[1]`.
- Confirms PR #3697's verifier compares the full result with the full target matrix. The control does not expose a defect in that PR.

This is a scoped verification result. It does not re-prove the inherited PR #3589 lower bound, claim a new minimum, or establish a physical supplier, invoice, or kappa change. Attribution to Nick Petalas and the PR #3570/#3578/#3589 lineage is retained in the package.

## Verification

- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-dirty-restoration-boundary-audit --check-only` — `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-dirty-restoration-boundary-audit` — registered replay passed, 24 exact endpoint cases and the negative control.
- `python3 -O -B research/q8-dirty-restoration-boundary-audit/verify.py` — passed under optimized Python.
- `python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/q8-dirty-restoration-boundary-audit` — committed-byte check passed for all five files.
- The optional `--check-source-history` mode could not run because this sparse worktree does not contain full Git history.

Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; priority revision 6. Local commit: `c0e26ee878ffb168b3fc824cd2a3e12d68eb083f`.

## Publication validation

The registered package replay passed on CPython 3.12.3 with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-dirty-restoration-boundary-audit`. The optional `--check-source-history` preflight could not run because this MacBook checkout is shallow and the checker requires full Git history. This package's source manifest pins only files at its exact base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; it contains no `head:` source pins. Any earlier pending note above refers to the state before this publication-time replay.
